Package com.userservice.app.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.userservice.app.model.User
@Entity public class User extends Object
Represents a user in the system.

This class defines the User entity with attributes such as personal information, geographical location, and associated user survey details. It maps to the "user" table in the "userservice" schema of the database.

The User entity includes:

  • id: A unique identifier for the user (primary key).
  • firstName: The user's first name.
  • lastName: The user's last name.
  • dob: The user's date of birth.
  • email: The user's email address, which must be unique.
  • longitude: The user's geographical longitude.
  • latitude: The user's geographical latitude.
  • savedMoney: The amount of money saved by the user.
  • userSurvey: A one-to-one relationship with the UserSurvey entity, representing additional survey details.

Key aspects:

  • Uses Jakarta Persistence annotations to map the class to a database table.
  • Employs Lombok annotations to automatically generate boilerplate code such as getters, setters, and constructors.
  • Defines cascading and fetch strategies for the relationship with UserSurvey.

Constructors:

  • No-args constructor for default initialization.
  • All-args constructor for full initialization of all fields.
